text: HSBC Holdings plc is a listed company (London, Hong Kong, New York, Bermuda). Its 2025 Form 20-F ('Notifiable interests in share capital') reports that it received no notification of major holdings of voting rights under UK DTR Rule 5 during 2025, and lists the notified interests on its Hong Kong SFO section 336 register as: BlackRock, Inc., long position of 9.09% of ordinary shares (notice of 16 July 2025); Ping An Asset Management Co., Ltd., long position of 7.98% of ordinary shares (notice of 10 May 2024); and The Bank of New York Mellon Corporation, long position of 6.01% as depositary for the HSBC ADSs (notice of 17 October 2025).
short: HSBC Holdings' notified major interests: BlackRock 9.09%, Ping An Asset Management 7.98%, BNY Mellon 6.01% (ADS depositary).

source.name: HSBC: Form 20-F 2025 (as filed with the SEC 26 February 2026), 'Notifiable interests in share capital'
source.quote: BlackRock, Inc. gave notice on 16 July 2025 that on 11 July 2025 it had the following interests in HSBC Holdings ordinary shares
source.note: Same section (p. 283): 'Ping An Asset Management Co., Ltd. gave notice on 10 May 2024 that on 7 May 2024 it had a long position of 1,502,584,731 in HSBC Holdings ordinary shares, representing 7.98%'; BNY Mellon 6.01% long as depositary for the HSBC ADSs; 'During 2025, HSBC Holdings did not receive any notification of major holdings of voting rights' under DTR Rule 5.
